name: Elixir of Agony
summary: In Hillsbrad Foothills, you gather toxic fungi from an overrun farmstead for Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill. The Mudsnout Blossoms will fuel the Royal Apothecary Society’s experiments, as Lady Sylvanas seeks a plague against the living and the Scourge.

sections.title: A Plague in the Making
sections.body: The Scourge ravages the north, while the Alliance clings to towns like Southshore. In Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon works under the Dark Lady’s command to develop a plague against both. He finds alchemy tedious, yet gathers potent organic toxins from the countryside to brew elixirs meant to hasten the destruction of Sylvanas’s enemies.

sections.title: The Fields of Nethander Stead
sections.body: Nethander Stead lies south of Tarren Mill and east of the river. The abandoned human farmstead is overrun by vicious Mudsnout gnolls. Mudsnout Blossoms, foul-smelling mushrooms, grow among its filth and neglected soil. Their concentrated organic poisons are prized by the Royal Apothecary Society. You can cut through the gnoll packs or weave quietly past their ramshackle camps to gather them.

faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon is a Royal Apothecary Society alchemist stationed at Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills. He serves Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, refining lethal mixtures and developing a new plague to defeat the living and the Scourge.

faq.q: What are Mudsnout Blossoms used for?
faq.answer: Mudsnout Blossoms are foul-smelling mushrooms from Nethander Stead. Lydon uses their potent natural toxins to brew the Elixir of Agony, part of the Forsaken’s chemical and biological warfare research.

Nethander Stead is an overgrown farmstead south of Tarren Mill and east of the major river that runs past Southshore. Aggressive Mudsnout gnolls have claimed the farm and guard the fields where the mushrooms grow.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken want to create a new plague?
faq.answer: Lady Sylvanas and the Forsaken seek a weapon to eliminate both the Scourge and the Alliance’s hostile living races. The Royal Apothecary Society works to secure the Forsaken’s sovereignty and survival in Lordaeron with a plague of their own.

faq.q: Why does Lydon complain about having to brew these elixirs?
faq.answer: Lydon is weary and morbid; he observes that humans and the Scourge already slaughter one another without help. Still, he obeys Lady Sylvanas’s wish to hasten their mutual destruction and continues brewing deadly mixtures.

faq.q: What happens after collecting the blossoms?
faq.answer: After Lydon receives the Mudsnout Blossoms, he brews the toxic mixture and soon needs more ingredients and field testing to make the elixir as lethal as possible.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you help the Royal Apothecary Society defend Lordaeron from humanity and the Lich King.
As a herbalist or forager, you may recognize the Mudsnout Blossom as a rare, extraordinarily toxic fungus that grows in unworked soil tainted by gnoll habitation.
As a Horde emissary in Tarren Mill, you assist your Forsaken allies while facing their unsettling chemical experiments.
